description: Missing access control on a state-mutating function allows any caller to permanently corrupt state and DoS core operations

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: Public entry point called by an unprivileged address (no access control revert)
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: Unprivileged call mutates state; downstream core operation subsequently reverts
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: Full DoS chain: attacker locks state, all user-facing operations revert, no recovery path proven

high_severity_rationale: For DoS of core deposit/withdraw operations with no on-chain recovery path (requires governance upgrade), L3C through the full call chain is both achievable and required. Impact = all users blocked from the strategy until governance acts.
negative_control_template: Call the same functions after price rises organically. Assert all operations succeed (no revert). Confirms the DoS is specifically caused by the spike-lock mechanism, not normal conditions.
